# vMLX 1.6.73

This release improves GLM 5.3 Flash and Naive N0.5 loading, native caching, reasoning controls and streamed responses, and updates the macOS runtime to MLX 0.32.3 with JANG 2.5.49.

- Preserve native prose and tool-call boundaries in streamed Chat and Responses output, including code examples.
- Normalize supported reasoning-effort values consistently before forwarding them to native model templates; reject malformed nested effort types.
- Reuse the longest valid Naive sliding-window checkpoint after cache normalization and compact detached prompt snapshots.
- Avoid duplicate GLM disk-checkpoint reconstruction and release completed SSD companion payloads promptly.
- Preserve configured allocator limits during multimodal generation.
- Report completed Naive prefill timing and keep tool-turn timing statistics scoped to the exchange.
- Preserve qualified GLM and Qwen prefill/decode paths with MLX 0.32.3.

Performance depends on model, quantization, context and hardware. Experimental JANGH weighted-prefill reduction and GLM DSA score tiling remain opt-in; this release does not promise universal throughput gains or eliminate model-owned answer-quality limitations.

Tahoe is the default macOS build; Sequoia is the compatibility build. Both Apple Silicon DMGs are Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. Python wheel and source distributions accompany the release.
